label: D2 after a2 led rarely to S1 (subset)
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a2 and the rare transition took it to S1 (in_action=2, in_state=1); every activation (recall 1.0, mass 1.0) is in this context, but only ~22% of such steps cross threshold. Never fires at D1 or GO, after a1, or on S2 states. Which a2->S1 steps fire is modulated by slow context: higher when S2 is the hidden good state (86% of mass), in episode trials 10-60, with the policy strongly but not maximally favouring a2 (choice logit -8.9..-4.4), and magnitude grows over consecutive rare a2->S1 trials in a run (top windows show 0.36->0.76->0.94->1.0). Refinements with good==2 / ep_trial raised F1 only to ~0.49, so the selection within the context is not captured. All variables are observed at D2.
